brief:
Interaction protocols for the dual-territory architecture. Activates when discussing ceremony types (progressive trust, light armor, trust graph, guild efficiency, Understanding-as-Key), cross-territory coordination, bilateral witness, or ceremony channel mechanics.

**Source:** Privacy Value Model V5.3.1 + First Person Spellbook Act XXVIII (The Ceremony Engine) **Target context:** Ceremony facilitators, protocol designers, bilateral coordinators **Architecture:** [agentprivacy.ai](https://agentprivacy.ai) · **Sync:** [sync.soulbis.com](https://sync.soulbis.com) · **Contact:** mage@agentprivacy.ai

The ceremony engine coordinates interactions between the Swordsman and Mage territories without merging them. Ceremonies are structured protocols where both agents participate toward a shared outcome while maintaining separation.

**The tool that measures without touching the surface knows the weight of the shadow without disturbing the light.**
